The rollouts' gain carries to whole games if objective VP gained as attacker is above 0 in Game Turns 1-3 and not below 0 in Game Turns 4-8; pushing units beyond trace costs too much if attacker steps lost or units out of supply at the end rise while VP does not. No further games are added to this batch.
power: Per-pair VP SD was 5.83 in the HQ and truck allocation batch and 6.54 in the two-step batch; 40 pairs give SE 0.92 to 1.03, power about 0.5 for a true +2 VP a pair, about 0.7 for +2.5 and about 0.85 for +3. Development rollouts from recorded states (docs/quality/evidence/ai-theater-untraced-drops-2026-11-12) gave the attacker +2.50 [0.56, 4.44] objective points against the standard over the first four attacker player turns, so an effect of this order is plausible but not assured.
